tasks.short: Signal equipment operators during alignment and material movement

steps.what: Check the agreed movement instructions and signalling arrangement
Observe machinery, material alignment and the movement area
Signal equipment operators and stop unsafe movements

tasks.design: Keep live observation and operator signalling with the construction laborer. The existing movement instruction in {DOCS} remains the reference; no document template replaces understanding the arrangement or watching actual clearances.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value is real-time visibility, agreed signals and intervention.
tasks.enabler_now: No labour-removing digital change is established for these operations.
tasks.still_hard: Changing clearances, people entering the area and communication failures demand immediate action.
tasks.human_edge: The signaler sees a hazard and stops the movement.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in signalling authority or physical presence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: equipment signalling requires direct observation and agreed real-time communication; a paperwork assistant does not replace it.

assumptions: Boundary is a movement already covered by existing site instructions, through live signalling. It is not preparation of a new lift plan, permit or incident report. Any actual required permit, record entry or written escalation in the local operation must be added as real work before a wider estimate.

The site supervisor supplies the existing movement arrangement and signal protocol. s1 includes retrieval, reading and manual clarification. The laborer produces live clearance observations in s2; no structured position feed, camera classification or new capture is assumed.

Before choosing zero, separate instruction review from the physical operation and inspect native views/templates and actual record or send duties. A shorter link does not remove the required review here, and no separate routine movement log is established. Do not invent one.
No new system, capture or monitoring is introduced, so upkeep is zero. Shares are provisional estimates of the laborer's effort only; equipment-operator time is neither removed nor credited.
unknowns: Required movement permits or records for the actual site
research_questions: Observe one movement and separately identify any actual permit, written handover or record duty

incremental.description: No new technology or ongoing capture is introduced for live signalling.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Instruction understanding, clearance observation and live signalling stay fully retained. No removable repeated document interaction or existing record/send is established in this movement boundary.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read construction plans and instructions to determine work activities

steps.what: Retrieve the current plans, instructions and specifications for the assigned work
Read plans and specifications to determine construction work activities
Clarify conflicting instructions and confirm the required activities

tasks.design: Configure the work assignment's native links to current plans and specifications in {DOCS}. Only repeated document navigation shrinks; the laborer reads and interprets the actual requirements and asks the supervisor about conflicts.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct work-area documents interrupts plan reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Native assignment links can point to released document revisions.
tasks.still_hard: Plans can conflict with site conditions or omit necessary detail.
tasks.human_edge: The laborer recognises that an instruction cannot safely be followed as written.
tasks.altitude: Work interpretation and escalation remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document links can shorten finding released construction instructions without interpreting drawings for the worker.

assumptions: Boundary is retrieving, reading and clarifying existing plans to understand assigned work. It does not invent an activity report or assume a new written method statement. Actual marked-up plans, clarification requests or sends must be included if locally required.

Existing document control supplies drawing identifier, revision, work area and release status; the site supervisor supplies the assignment. s1 includes checking these fields, manual missing-link lookup and fallback to the site document register. No new tagging duty or extraction is free.

Try native links first. Three points of s1 navigation disappear; 12 points remain for revision checking and manual fallback. All 65 interpretation points and 20 clarification points stay retained. No system runtime or template-reading saving is claimed.
All shares and upkeep are provisional model estimates.
unknowns: Rate of missing or superseded drawing references
research_questions: Can the native link follow a released revision without hiding supersession warnings?
Separate navigation from plan interpretation on a work assignment

already_counted.description: Verify release status and manually trace missing or incorrect document links.

incremental.description: Check assignment-to-document links after revision changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes three navigation points less 0.5 upkeep. Conservative newly revised work area has incomplete links and requires manual register tracing, leaving only 0.8 point of direct retrieval removable: 0.3 net. Interpretation remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A laborer retaining hands-on safety and interpretation, with easier retrieval of current work documents.
skills_to_grow: Verify drawing release and work-area references
role.ambitious_version: Make the current instructions easier to find while preserving direct observation and safe physical work.
